transcript.text: You could be a WrestleMania main eventer, you could be a Grand Slam champion, you could be the current WWE Champion and still somehow be the most underrated wrestler in the world.
Maybe it's my fault. I gave you guys too much credit. I thought you knew Paul. I thought you could identify greatness when it was standing right in front of you.
But the truth is you can't. You can't. You can't. You need to be spoon fed and told someone is great to get it.
That's why you got all these guys like Trick Williams. He tells you how great he is all the time. And what do you do?
What's that trick? What's that trick? Yeah, real good.
PM Punk, who every single time they come out here, they have to tell you they're the best in the world and you lap it up.
Or yeah, I guess he is the best in the world. You got guys like Roman Reigns who have to come out here, stand in this ring and demand that you acknowledge them.
